one_line: Marthanda Varma, ruler of Travancore, and his Dalawa (prime minister) Ramayyan, enforcing the royal pepper monopoly across the Kuttakam lands.

appearance.age_look: Marthanda Varma appears in his late 30s, tall and broad-shouldered with a regal bearing; Ramayyan appears in his mid-40s, slightly leaner but sturdy, with the alert posture of an administrator who often travels and inspects.
appearance.face: Marthanda Varma has an oval face, medium-brown Kerala complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, and intense, slightly narrowed anime eyes with a calm but commanding default expression; Ramayyan has a slightly longer face, similar medium-brown tone, a straighter, more thoughtful gaze, thin moustache, and a steady, assessing default expression.
appearance.hair: Marthanda Varma’s thick black hair is oiled and pulled back into a low knot at the back of the head wrapped by a narrow white cloth band, topped with a small dark-red cloth turban cap with a gold border; Ramayyan’s black hair is similarly oiled and pulled into a small knot at the back, partially covered by a simple off-white cloth headband tied at the back, no turban.
appearance.costume: Marthanda Varma wears an 18th-century Kerala royal outfit: a long-sleeved off-white cotton angarkha-style upper garment that wraps across the chest and ties at the side, reaching mid-thigh with a slight flare, edged with a narrow gold border; below he wears a rich deep-red mundu (wrap) tied around the waist, pleated in front, falling to the ankles, with a broad golden kasavu border; over one shoulder is a light cream silk shawl with thin gold stripes; his chest and arms are modestly covered, with simple gold bangles, a medium-thickness gold chain with a small round pendant, and a narrow waist belt of red fabric with a faint floral pattern; his feet are in brown leather sandals. Ramayyan wears a simpler administrator’s dress: a plain off-white long-sleeved cotton shirt (kurta-like, slightly loose, reaching mid-thigh) with a round neck and a short front opening laced with a small tie, fully covering his torso; he wears a pale pastel-green mundu with a thin off-white border, wrapped to the ankles, and a narrow dark-brown cloth belt; over his left shoulder he has a practical off-white cotton angavastram folded neatly, and he wears simple wooden sandals; both have minimal but era-accurate jewellery, with Ramayyan wearing only a small black-bead and thread necklace for modesty and a single copper bangle on his right wrist.
appearance.signature: Marthanda Varma carries a sheathed, gently-curved steel sword with a simple brass hilt and red cloth-wrapped grip, hanging from a plain dark-brown leather belt at his left hip, while Ramayyan holds a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with string and a small writing stylus tucked into his waist belt, symbolizing enforcement of the pepper monopoly and administrative control.

ref_desc: Marthanda Varma is a medium-brown, oval-faced Kerala king with oiled black hair in a knot under a small dark-red gold-bordered turban, in off-white long-sleeved angarkha, deep-red kasavu-bordered mundu, cream-gold shawl and brown sandals, carrying a curved sword at his hip, beside Ramayyan, a medium-brown, lean official with oiled hair knot and off-white headband, in a simple off-white long-sleeved kurta, pastel-green mundu, off-white angavastram and wooden sandals, holding a rolled palm-leaf manuscript and stylus; their shared palette is off-white, deep red, gold, pastel green and dark brown.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of two fixed figures from 18th-century Travancore: Marthanda Varma and Ramayyan Dalawa, standing side by side against a plain background. Marthanda Varma is a medium-brown, oval-faced Kerala king with a sharp jawline and calm, commanding anime eyes, thick black hair oiled back into a knot wrapped by a narrow white band, topped with a small dark-red cloth turban cap edged in gold. He wears a long-sleeved off-white cotton angarkha-style upper garment that wraps and ties at the side, fully covering his torso and reaching mid-thigh with a narrow gold border, a rich deep-red ankle-length mundu with a broad golden kasavu border, and a light cream silk shoulder shawl striped with thin gold lines; he has simple gold bangles, a gold chain pendant, a narrow red-patterned waist belt, and brown leather sandals, and at his left hip hangs a sheathed gently-curved steel sword with a brass hilt and red cloth-wrapped grip. Beside him, Ramayyan Dalawa is slightly leaner with a medium-brown complexion, longer face, thoughtful anime eyes, and a thin moustache, his black hair oiled into a small back knot under an off-white cloth headband. He wears a loose long-sleeved off-white cotton kurta reaching mid-thigh with a round neck and laced opening, a pale pastel-green ankle-length mundu with a thin off-white border held by a dark-brown cloth belt, an off-white angavastram folded over his left shoulder, a single copper bangle, a small thread necklace, and simple wooden sandals; in his hands is a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with string, with a small stylus tucked at his waist. Emphasize consistent face shapes, hair knots and headwear, the specific off-white, deep red, gold, pastel-green and dark-brown colour palette, and show their sword and palm-leaf manuscript clearly in multiple views so they can be redrawn identically.
